meta.rule: Hours and prices only where an official page prints them. Blank means not verified. 'per couple' means cost for 2 adults.
meta.activity_social_rule: Only links seen on or found for the named venue. Instagram/TikTok handles left blank rather than guessed.

activities.name: Sphere Las Vegas (The Wizard of Oz / concerts)
activities.exceptions: The 2027 show calendar at this venue is not yet fully published. Prices shown are the vendor's current listing, not a February 2027 rate.
activities.price_note: Sphere does not print a single admission price — it depends on the show. Booking.com's own listing shows 'Admission to The Wizard of Oz at The Sphere' from $131.45 per person; that is a reseller price, not the venue's box office price.
activities.notes: The single most distinctive thing to do in Las Vegas right now. Book only once the 2027 calendar is live.

activities.name: High Roller Observation Wheel
activities.hours: Opens 12:30 PM; last admission at close. Ticket windows: daytime 12–5 PM, anytime from 6 PM.
activities.exceptions: 30 minutes for one full rotation; allow an hour including boarding.
activities.price_note: Official FAQ: adult daytime $23.50, adult anytime $34.75, Happy Half Hour (21+) $60. Each is 'plus taxes and fees'. Two adults at the two standard tiers = $47.00 and $69.50 before tax.
activities.notes: Happy Half Hour is an open-bar cabin with a bartender for the full rotation.

activities.name: The Mob Museum
activities.hours: Museum: Sun–Wed & Fri–Sat 9:00 AM–9:00 PM, Thu 9:00 AM–4:00 PM · The Underground (speakeasy): 11:00 AM–11:00 PM (to midnight Fri–Sat)
activities.exceptions: Hours subject to change; the museum publishes early-closure notices — e.g. Thanksgiving Day: museum 9 AM–4 PM, Underground 11 AM–5 PM.
activities.price_note: Official ticketing: General Admission $37.95 per adult (includes The Underground). Two adults = $75.90. Deluxe Pass $49.95 pp, Premier Pass $54.95 pp (both include one or two interactive experiences).
activities.notes: A morning-arrival discount and an evening-arrival discount are offered online only on the Premier Pass.

activities.name: The Neon Museum
activities.hours: Sep–May 3:00 PM – 11:00 PM (last entry 10:00 PM). Jun–Aug 8:00 PM – midnight.
activities.exceptions: From 1 Jan 2027 the separate daytime/evening tickets are replaced by a single '2027 Admission' valid across operating hours.
activities.price_note: Official site: 2027 Admission 'from $21' per person, daily 3–11 PM. Two adults from $42. The 2026 daytime tier was from $25 and the 2026 evening tier from $35 — both expire 31 Dec 2026, which is before the trip.
activities.notes: Social handles taken directly from the museum's own site footer. 45-minute guided History and Movies tours are add-ons.

activities.name: Fremont Street Experience
activities.hours: Canopy light shows and live music nightly; schedule published on the venue calendar
activities.price_note: Free entry. The venue states live concerts and performances run on three stages every night.
activities.notes: Free — the obvious way to keep a downtown evening cheap. SlotZilla zipline is a paid add-on on the same site.

not_verified.name: Bellagio Fountains
not_verified.reason: The official Bellagio page for the fountains returned a fetch error twice. Show times and the current schedule could not be confirmed, so no hours or links are published here. Free to watch; check https://www.bellagio.com/ on arrival.

not_verified.name: Cirque du Soleil / other production shows
not_verified.reason: Booking.com listed 'Cirque Du Soleil Admission' from $158.65 per person, but that is a reseller listing with no show name, no venue and no 2027 date. Not published as fact.
